page.overview:
Who is Hibari?

Hibari has brown hair which was drawn into a bun with a bang covering her right eye. She wore a multi-coloured yellow blouse along with pair of shorts and sandals. She also has big black eyes.

She was a classmate of Konohamaru Sarutobi's in the Academy. She asked Iruka who the Fifth Hokage was, only to find out that at the time, there wasn't one.
